docs.title: What is Tempo?
docs.text:
Tempo is an Unreal Engine modding tool, that covers project management, automated builds, and more, built by Tempo-Organization.

  • Rapid development

    Speeds up your mod creation by streamlining various tasks.

  • Cross platform

    Tempo runs on Windows and Linux.

  • Project Management

    Organizes mods, builds, and configurations in one place.

  • Open Source

    Tempo is licensed under GPL3.

  • Compatibility

    Tempo supports all unreal engine 4 and 5 versions.

  • CI Friendly

    Integrates easily into automated build and CI pipelines.

docs.text: Welcome to the Tempo FAQ. Here we try and answer any question that comes up frequently. If you can't find what you are looking for here, see our other help channels.

docs.title: What platforms does Tempo support?
docs.text: Currently we support Windows (x86-64 and i686) and Linux (x86-64 and aarch64).

docs.title: As a game developer, can I use this for my game's mod support?
docs.text: Yes, the license fully allows this, and we would love to see it.

docs.title: Can I use relative paths, in my tempo config?
docs.text: Yes, this is fully supported.

docs.title: I get a "Stage Failed. Missing receipt '../Platform-Configuration.target'." error, what should I do?
docs.text: If Unreal asks you to build a target, it means the executable for that configuration/platform hasn't been compiled yet. Please build the target, usually Win64/Shipping, with your preferred method.

Tempo runs on Windows and Linux.

  • Git

docs.title: Adding to your PATH
docs.text:
To run the prebuilt executables from any terminal, you should add them to your system PATH:

WindowsLinux

Windows:

  1. Move tempo_cli.exe to a folder of your choice (e.g. C:\programs\tempo_cli).
  2. Open Settings → System → About → Advanced system settings → Environment Variables.
  3. Under System Variables, select Path and click Edit.
  4. Click New and add the folder path where tempo_cli.exe is located (e.g. C:\programs\tempo_cli).
  5. Click OK to save changes. Open a new Command Prompt to use tempo_cli from any directory.

Linux:

  1. Move tempo_cli to a folder of your choice (e.g., /usr/local/bin).
  2. Make sure it’s executable: 
chmod +x /usr/local/bin/tempo_cli
  1. If the folder isn’t already in your PATH, add it by editing your shell config file (~/.bashrc, ~/.zshrc, etc.):
export PATH=$PATH:/usr/local/bin
  1. Reload your shell:
source ~/.bashrc

You can now run tempo_cli from any directory.

docs.title: Settings
docs.text:
Tempo stores its configuration as a JSON object. Settings are grouped into sections based on the part of Tempo they control.

Note: Not every setting is required. Many settings can be inferred automatically from other configuration values, environment variables, or detected Unreal Engine information.

docs.title: Configuration Structure
docs.text:
• mods_info
  • game_info
  • engine_info
  • process_kill_events
  • window_management_events
  • exec_events
  • git_info
  • repak_info
  • cache
  • packaging_uproject_name
  • optionals

docs.title: Mods Info
docs.text:
mods_info contains the configuration for each mod.

{
    "mods_info": {
        "ExampleMod": {
            "persistent_files_directory": "C:/Path/To/Persistent/Files/Directory",
            "auto_include_mod_name_dir_name": true,
            "packing_type": "unreal_pak",
            "pak_chunk_num": 1,
            "sig_method_type": "copy",
            "is_enabled": true,
            "pak_dir_structure": "~mods",
            "compression_type": "Zlib",
            "mod_name_dir_type": "Mods",
            "mod_name_dir_name_override": "ExampleModNameDirNameOverride",
            "file_includes": {
                "asset_paths": [
                    "Content/Mods/Folder/AssetName",
                    "Content/Mods/Folder/AssetNameTwo"
                ],
                "tree_paths": [
                    "Content/Mods/FolderTwo",
                    "Content/GameModes/GunGame"
                ]
            }
        },
        "AnotherMod": {
            "persistent_files_directory": "C:/Path/To/Another/Persistent/Files/Directory",
            "auto_include_mod_name_dir_name": false,
            "packing_type": "engine",
            "pak_chunk_num": 2,
            "sig_method_type": "none",
            "is_enabled": true,
            "pak_dir_structure": "~mods",
            "compression_type": "Oodle",
            "mod_name_dir_type": "Mods",
            "mod_name_dir_name_override": "AnotherModNameDir",
            "file_includes": {
                "asset_paths": [
                    "Content/AnotherMod/AssetOne",
                    "Content/AnotherMod/AssetTwo"
                ],
                "tree_paths": [
                    "Content/AnotherMod",
                    "Content/Weapons"
                ]
            }
        }
    }
}

docs.title: General Mod Settings
docs.text: Setting Description mod_name Name of the mod. persistent_files_directory Directory containing files that should persist between operations, useful for edited cooked assets, and inis. auto_include_mod_name_dir_name Automatically includes the files in the at Content/ModNameDirType/ModName tree in various operations, defaults to true. packing_type Determines the type of package produced for the mod. pak_chunk_num Chunk number used when creating the pak. sig_method_type Signature method used for the generated package. is_enabled Determines whether the mod is enabled, if not specified, defaults to true. pak_dir_structure Determines the directory structure used to place the mod files in your game's Paks directory, and for releases. compression_type Compression method used when packaging the mod. mod_name_dir_type What foldername to automatically include files for, often is Mods, or CustomContent. mod_name_dir_name_override Overrides the automatically generated mod-name directory. Can be useful for internally having a nice folder name, while having a _P in your final file name. file_includes.asset_paths Individual Unreal asset paths to include. file_includes.tree_paths Paths to directory trees where all files with be included.

docs.title: Game Info
docs.text:
game_info describes the game that Tempo is managing.

{
    "game_info": {
        "game_exe_path": "C:/Games/Example/Game.exe",
        "game_launcher_exe": "C:/Programs/Steam/Steam.exe",
        "window_title_override": "Example Game",
        "launch_type": "steam",
        "game_id": "123456",
        "launch_params": [
            "--param_one",
            "--param_two"
        ],
        "is_iostore": false
    }
}

docs.title: Settings
docs.text: Setting Description game_exe_path Path to the game's executable. game_launcher_exe Optional launcher executable used to start the game. window_title_override Overrides the window title used when identifying the game window. launch_type Determines how the game is launched. Usually, through steam, or directly through the executable. game_id Game id for the game, often the steam app id. launch_params Additional parameters passed when launching the game. is_iostore Indicates whether the game uses Unreal Engine's IoStore packaging system, usually automatically determined.

docs.title: Engine Info
docs.text:
engine_info contains Unreal Engine and project configuration.

{
    "engine_info": {
        "unreal_engine_dir": "D:/UnrealEngine/UE_5.7",
        "unreal_project_file": "C:/Projects/Game/Game.uproject",
        "engine_building_args": [],
        "engine_packaging_args": [],
        "engine_cooking_args": [],
        "engine_launch_args": [],
        "build_type": "Shipping",
        "unreal_engine_major_version": 5,
        "unreal_engine_minor_version": 7,
        "build_target_platform": "Win64",
        "unreal_engine_target_platform": "WindowsNoEditor"
    }
}

docs.title: Settings
docs.text: Setting Description unreal_engine_dir Path to the Unreal Engine installation. unreal_project_file Path to the Unreal Engine .uproject file. engine_building_args Override the default arguments used when building the Unreal project. engine_packaging_args Override the default arguments used when packaging the project. engine_cooking_args Override the default arguments used when cooking the project. engine_launch_args Override the default arguments used when launching the project or game. build_type Determines the type of Unreal Engine build to perform. unreal_engine_major_version Unreal Engine major version, such as 4 or 5. unreal_engine_minor_version Unreal Engine minor version, such as 27 or 7. build_target_platform Platform targeted when building the project. unreal_engine_target_platform Platform targeted by Unreal Engine operations.

docs.title: Process Kill Events
docs.text:
process_kill_events controls processes that Tempo monitors for to terminate.

{
    "process_kill_events": {
        "processes": [
            {
                "hook_state": "pre_game_launch",
                "use_substring_check": true,
                "process_name": "ExampleGame.exe"
            },
            {
                "hook_state": "post_game_launch",
                "use_substring_check": false,
                "process_name": "ExampleLauncher.exe"
            }
        ],
        "auto_close_game": true
    }
}
Setting Description hook_state Controls when this process management event will fire. use_substring_check Determines whether the process name is matched as a substring rather than exactly. process_name Name of the process to monitor. auto_close_game Controls whether Tempo automatically closes the game as needed for various file operations and testing.

docs.title: Window Management Events
docs.text:
window_management_events Allows management of application windows through Tempo.

{
    "window_management_events": [
        {
            "hook_state": "pre_game_launch",
            "use_substring_check": true,
            "window_name": "Example Game",
            "window_behaviour": {
                "position": {
                    "x": 0,
                    "y": 0
                },
                "resolution": {
                    "width": 1920,
                    "height": 1080
                }
            }
        },
        {
            "hook_state": "post_game_launch",
            "use_substring_check": false,
            "window_name": "Another Game",
            "window_behaviour": {
                "position": {
                    "x": 100,
                    "y": 100
                },
                "resolution": {
                    "width": 1280,
                    "height": 720
                }
            }
        }
    ]
}

docs.title: Settings
docs.text: Setting Description hook_state Controls when this window management event will fire. use_substring_check Determines whether window_name is matched as a substring. window_name Name of the window to manage. window_behaviour Determines how the window should be managed. position.x Horizontal position of the window. position.y Vertical position of the window. resolution.width Width of the window. resolution.height Height of the window.

docs.title: Exec Events
docs.text:
exec_events defines commands or executables that Tempo can launch.

{
    "exec_events": [
        {
            "hook_state": "pre_game_launch",
            "alt_exe_path": "C:/Path/To/Executable.exe",
            "variable_args": [
                "--param_one",
                "--param_two"
            ],
            "execution_mode": "sync"
        },
        {
            "hook_state": "post_game_launch",
            "alt_exe_path": "C:/Path/To/AnotherExecutable.exe",
            "variable_args": [
                "--example",
                "--another_param"
            ],
            "execution_mode": "async"
        }
    ]
}

docs.title: Settings
docs.text: Setting Description hook_state Controls when this execution management event will fire. alt_exe_path executable path. variable_args Arguments that can be supplied to run when executing the program. execution_mode Determines how the executable is launched.

docs.title: Git Info
docs.text:
git_info contains Git repository configuration.

{
    "git_info": {
        "repo_path": "C:/Projects/MyMod"
    }
}
Setting Description repo_path Path to the Git repository associated with the project.

docs.title: Repak Info
docs.text:
repak_info controls the version and compression settings used by Repak.

{
    "repak_info": {
        "repak_compression_type": "Zlib",
        "repak_version": "V4",
        "repak_pack_version": "v0.2.3"
    }
}
Setting Description repak_compression_type Compression method passed to Repak. repak_version Version of Repak to use. repak_pack_version Pak format version to generate.

docs.title: Cache
docs.text:
cache controls Tempo's local cache.

{
    "cache": {
        "cache_dir": "..."
    }
}
Setting Description cache_dir Directory where Tempo stores cached files and data.

docs.title: Packaging Uproject Name
docs.text:
packaging_uproject_name controls the name used when packaging a project.

{
    "packaging_uproject_name": {
        "name": "ExampleProject"
    }
}
Setting Description name Uproject name used during packaging.

Note: This setting is intended to be revisited. In the future, the name may be derived from engine_info or game_info.

docs.title: Optionals
docs.text:
optionals contains optional paths to external tools.

{
    "optionals": {
        "ide_path": "C:/Program Files/IDE/IDE.exe",
        "blender_path": "C:/Program Files/Blender Foundation/Blender/blender.exe"
    }
}
Setting Description ide_path Path to the IDE used for development. blender_path Path to the Blender executable.

These settings are optional and are only required when the corresponding tool is used by a workflow.

docs.title: Minimal Configuration
docs.text:
A minimal configuration does not necessarily need to specify every available setting.

For example:

{
    "game_info": {
        "game_exe_path": "C:/Games/Example/Game.exe"
    },
    "engine_info": {
        "unreal_engine_dir": "D:/UnrealEngine/UE_5.7",
        "unreal_project_file": "C:/Projects/Example/Example.uproject"
    }
}

Tempo can derive additional information from these paths where possible.

docs.title: Configuration Precedence
docs.text:
In general, settings may be supplied through:

  1. Command-line arguments
  2. Environment variables
  3. Environment files
  4. Configuration files
  5. Default values or automatically detected system information

The effective priority is:

command line > environment variable > environment file > configuration > default/auto-detected

Note: Environment files are currently not supported.

docs.title: Environment Variables
docs.text: Tempo supports a number of environment variables for configuring engine paths, tool versions, caching, networking, and other behavior.

docs.title: UNREAL_ENGINE_DIRECTORY_MAJOR_MINOR
docs.text:
Specifies the Unreal Engine installation directory for a specific major and minor version.

For example:

UNREAL_ENGINE_DIRECTORY_5_7

docs.title: TEMPO_UNREAL_ENGINE_DIRECTORY_MAJOR_MINOR
docs.text:
Tempo-specific equivalent of UNREAL_ENGINE_DIRECTORY_MAJOR_MINOR.

For example:

TEMPO_UNREAL_ENGINE_DIRECTORY_5_7

docs.title: UNREAL_ENGINE_MAJOR_VERSION
docs.text:
Specifies the Unreal Engine major version.

UNREAL_ENGINE_MAJOR_VERSION=5

docs.title: UNREAL_ENGINE_MINOR_VERSION
docs.text:
Specifies the Unreal Engine minor version.

UNREAL_ENGINE_MINOR_VERSION=7

docs.title: TEMPO_UNREAL_ENGINE_MAJOR_VERSION
docs.text:
Tempo-specific Unreal Engine major version.

TEMPO_UNREAL_ENGINE_MAJOR_VERSION=5

docs.title: TEMPO_UNREAL_ENGINE_MINOR_VERSION
docs.text:
Tempo-specific Unreal Engine minor version.

TEMPO_UNREAL_ENGINE_MINOR_VERSION=7

docs.title: TEMPO_PERSISTENT_MODS_DIRECTORY
docs.text:
Specifies the directory where Tempo should store persistent mod data

TEMPO_PERSISTENT_MODS_DIRECTORY=C:\Tempo\Mods

docs.title: TEMPO_DUMP_PATTERNSLEUTH_VERSION
docs.text:
Specifies the version of PatternSleuth used by Tempo when dumping or inspecting Unreal Engine data.

TEMPO_DUMP_PATTERNSLEUTH_VERSION=1.2.3

docs.title: TEMPO_REPAK_PACK_VERSION
docs.text:
Specifies the version of the repak package format to use.

TEMPO_REPAK_PACK_VERSION=4

docs.title: TEMPO_REPAK_COMPRESSION_TYPE
docs.text:
Specifies the compression type used when creating repak archives.

TEMPO_REPAK_COMPRESSION_TYPE=Zlib

docs.title: PATTERNSLEUTH_RES_EngineVersion
docs.text:
Specifies the Unreal Engine version used by PatternSleuth resource data.

PATTERNSLEUTH_RES_EngineVersion=5.7

docs.title: TEMPO_FORCE_ONLINE
docs.text:
Forces Tempo and supported tools to operate in online mode.

TEMPO_FORCE_ONLINE=1

docs.title: TEMPO_FORCE_OFFLINE
docs.text:
Forces Tempo and supported tools to operate in offline mode.

TEMPO_FORCE_OFFLINE=1

TEMPO_FORCE_ONLINE and TEMPO_FORCE_OFFLINE should not normally be enabled at the same time.

docs.title: GITHUB_TOKEN
docs.text:
Provides a GitHub authentication token for operations that require access to the GitHub API.

GITHUB_TOKEN=...

Avoid committing authentication tokens to source control.

docs.title: Tool Caching
docs.text: The following variables use TOOLNAME as a placeholder for the name of the relevant tool.

docs.title: TOOLNAME_NO_CACHE
docs.text:
Disables caching for the tool.

TOOLNAME_NO_CACHE=1

docs.title: TOOLNAME_CACHE_DIR
docs.text:
Specifies the directory used for the tool's cache.

TOOLNAME_CACHE_DIR=C:\Tempo\Cache

docs.title: TOOLNAME_CACHE_FORCE_ONLINE
docs.text:
Forces the tool to use online resources when resolving cached resources.

TOOLNAME_CACHE_FORCE_ONLINE=1

docs.title: TOOLNAME_CACHE_FORCE_OFFLINE
docs.text:
Forces the tool to operate using locally cached resources.

TOOLNAME_CACHE_FORCE_OFFLINE=1

docs.title: TEMPO_TOOLNAME_RELEASE_TAG
docs.text:
Forces the tool to use a specific release tag for a specific tool.

TEMPO_TOOLNAME_RELEASE_TAG=1.3

docs.title: TEMPO_TOOLNAME_DIR
docs.text:
Forces the tool to use a specific dir for the installation of a tool.

TEMPO_TOOLNAME_RELEASE_TAG=C:\Tempo\Tools\ToolName

docs.title: Quick Reference
docs.text: Variable Purpose TEMPO_PERSISTENT_MODS_DIRECTORY Persistent mod storage directory UNREAL_ENGINE_MAJOR_VERSION Unreal Engine major version UNREAL_ENGINE_MINOR_VERSION Unreal Engine minor version TEMPO_UNREAL_ENGINE_MAJOR_VERSION Tempo Unreal Engine major version TEMPO_UNREAL_ENGINE_MINOR_VERSION Tempo Unreal Engine minor version UNREAL_ENGINE_DIRECTORY_MAJOR_MINOR Unreal Engine installation directory TEMPO_UNREAL_ENGINE_DIRECTORY_MAJOR_MINOR Tempo Unreal Engine installation directory TEMPO_DUMP_PATTERNSLEUTH_VERSION PatternSleuth version PATTERNSLEUTH_RES_EngineVersion PatternSleuth engine version TEMPO_REPAK_PACK_VERSION repak package version TEMPO_REPAK_COMPRESSION_TYPE repak compression type GITHUB_TOKEN GitHub API authentication TEMPO_FORCE_ONLINE Force online operation TEMPO_FORCE_OFFLINE Force offline operation TOOLNAME_NO_CACHE Disable tool caching TOOLNAME_CACHE_DIR Tool cache directory TOOLNAME_CACHE_FORCE_ONLINE Force cache operations online TOOLNAME_CACHE_FORCE_OFFLINE Force cache operations offline
